abilities.name: Absorbing
abilities.text: Switches on an absorbing effect against one damage type at a time: Ballistic, Energy, Fire or Melee. Change to a different damage type while it is up.

abilities.name: Air tank weak point
abilities.text: The air tank on his back is a weak spot and can be blown up.

abilities.name: Air tank stagger
abilities.text: Blowing the air tank staggers him, the one time he can be staggered.

abilities.name: Air tank frenzy
abilities.text: The air tank blast can frenzy its target for a short time.

abilities.name: No stagger
abilities.text: Cannot be staggered by normal hits.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.text: Teleports around the arena. How often depends on which of his six combat styles is active.

setBonus.name: Secret Settler Armor Set Bonus
setBonus.text: Wearing the full Secret Settler set reflects ballistic damage back at whoever shot you.
